comparison.objective: Spot-weld a nickel strip across four battery cells; candidate installs a load-bearing rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-sheet placement and repeated welder-tip contact versus long-part bimanual leveling, spring-prong insertion, telescoping, and screw driving.
comparison.success_condition: Requires four weld contacts and tool return; candidate requires front/rear retention, matched rack units, full spring return, bottom-hole screws, and released support.
comparison.reason: Tool use and alignment are generic shared primitives; the tested assemblies and mechanical outcomes differ. Candidate insertion-force and damage thresholds are not yet numeric, but that does not suggest duplication.
